[P2] Resolve the untested startup-validation branch

`templates.test.ts` only reads this module as text, while the deployed conformance scenario supplies `TELEMETRY_LOG_GROUP_NAME`. Neither asserts the startup error for a missing or empty variable, leaving this rejection behavior unprotected. `CONTRIBUTING.md` rule 4 requires a behavioral test for each added branch; deploy-only handlers are not exempt. Return to the design phase under rules 8–9 and decide whether to omit this validation or retain it with a test that depends on this rejection path.
